definitions:
E1b: within-trajectory vs between-trajectory separation of inherited errors (VAL, read-only).

On Y=0 positions, positive = inherited (C=1); negatives = fresh clean (no earlier C=1) or recovered clean
(earlier C=1). For each negative type we count (inherited, clean) pairs:
  within   both positions in the same trajectory
  between  positions in different trajectories
AUROC_<type>_within  = correctly ordered within pairs / within pairs   (ties count 1/2)
AUROC_<type>_between = same over between pairs
AUROC_<type>_within_trajmean = mean over trajectories that contain both classes of the per-trajectory AUROC.
Within-trajectory fresh clean positions necessarily precede the first error of that trajectory.
95% CIs for within quantities from a trajectory bootstrap.
